item.title: Knowdit: Agentic Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Auditing Knowledge Summarization
item.description:
Summary

  • Proposes Knowdit, an agentic, knowledge-driven framework for smart contract vulnerability detection tailored to DeFi semantics.
  • Builds an auditing knowledge graph from historical human audit reports and links fine-grained DeFi mechanisms to recurring vulnerability patterns.
  • Uses a multi-agent iterative loop (spec generation, harness synthesis, fuzzing, and reflection) to detect known and previously unknown vulnerabilities.
  • Evaluated on Code4rena projects with strong results on high- and medium-severity vulnerability detection, with few false positives.

Paper Type

  • Research

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Ziqiao Kong', 'Wanxu Xia', 'Chong Wang', 'Yi Lu', 'Pan Li', 'Shaohua Li', 'Zong Cao', 'Yang Liu']
